keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! AZ 0, Groningen 1. Jacob Ondrejka (Groningen) header from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Goal! AZ 1, Groningen 1. Mexx Meerdink (AZ) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ro-Zangelo Daal.
First Half ends, AZ 1, Groningen 1.
Goal! AZ 1, Groningen 2. Brynjólfur Willumsson (Groningen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Jacob Ondrejka.
Goal! AZ 1, Groningen 3. Thom van Bergen (Groningen) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
Marco Rente (Groningen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty missed. Mexx Meerdink (AZ) left footed shot is too high.
Substitution, AZ. Kees Smit replaces Valdemar Byskov.
Substitution, AZ. Jordy Clasie replaces Wouter Goes.
Pelle Clement (Groningen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! AZ 2, Groningen 3. Ayoub Oufkir (AZ) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mexx Meerdink.
Delay in match because of an injury Ayoub Oufkir (AZ).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Groningen. Wouter Prins replaces Márk Csinger.
Substitution, Groningen. Tygo Land replaces Jacob Ondrejka.
Goal! AZ 3, Groningen 3. Mateo Chávez (AZ) left footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Groningen. Tyrique Mercera replaces Jorg Schreuders.
Substitution, AZ. Calvin Stengs replaces Ro-Zangelo Daal.
Substitution, AZ. Denso Kasius replaces Elijah Dijkstra.
Etienne Vaessen (Groningen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second yellow card to Etienne Vaessen (Groningen).
Substitution, Groningen. Lovro Stubljar replaces Tika de Jonge.
Substitution, Groningen. Nils Eggens replaces Brynjólfur Willumsson.
Goal! AZ 4, Groningen 3. Mexx Meerdink (AZ) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the top right corner.
Peer Koopmeiners (AZ) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, AZ. Mees de Wit replaces Mateo Chávez.
Hans Hateboer (Groningen) is shown the red card.
